summary: Full frontend regression on Endfield Protocol Dashboard PWA. Verified login (PIN 123456 authorizes), wrong-PIN AKSES DITOLAK error, brute-force lockout after 5 attempts (AKSES DIKUNCI ~60s), theme toggle (default dark, toggles theme-light on body, persists across reload via localStorage endfield_theme), Indonesian labels present, and all four sidebar utility modals open without JS errors. No uncaught JS errors observed (only expected cloudflareinsights CSP block, which was not present in this session).
critical_code_review_comments: dashboard.js and dashboard.css are large single files — consider modularizing for maintainability.
Login lockout uses localStorage which can be cleared client-side; acceptable for a static PWA but note this in security docs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Boot overlay hides via class 'is-complete' or display:none; wait ~2-3s after navigation. Clear localStorage 'endfield_login_lock_v1' before/after brute-force tests. Theme toggle button has data-testid='theme-toggle-button'. Sidebar modal buttons: #accountManagerButton, #diagnosticsButton, #historyButton, #settingsCenterButton. When testing sidebar modals in sequence, close via Escape or #modal .close-btn before clicking next — utility-overlay intercepts pointer events until dismissed.
